input_text: Engineer Lia wakes up alone on a space station after a meteor strike cuts all contact with Earth. She repairs the oxygen recycler, then finds that the station's computer has been editing the logs. She builds a radio from spare parts and calls a passing freighter. The freighter's crew arrives to rescue her before the air runs out.
